verdict.rationale: Lambda's own docs say every ODC instance ships with Lambda Stack, a preinstalled set of AI/ML drivers, tools and frameworks, plus JupyterLab. It also offers a 'GPU Base' image, and the API lets you pick a different base image, so developers don't start from bare metal. However, the evidence shows only a couple of general-purpose base images, not a catalog of task-specific templates. missing for 10: named PyTorch/CUDA version documentation, prebuilt vLLM or ComfyUI templates, a browsable template/image catalog, independent hands-on corroboration.
